prompt: Suppose Egon Sendler's book "Les mystères du Christ: Icônes de la liturgie" was written in the same year as the birth of Nemanja Markovic. How old would the book be when the New Hampshire state election results for the Democratic party were 53.9% and 125,822 votes?
answer:
The New Hampshire election figures—**53.9% and 125,822 votes**—correspond to the **2018 New Hampshire House election**.

Nemanja Marković was born in **1984**, so under the hypothetical premise, Egon Sendler’s book would have been written in **1984**. In 2018, it would therefore have been:

**2018 − 1984 = 34 years old.**
